rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who has left work after reaching retirement age.

example.english: They are retired and now go out for dim sum every day.
example.traditional: 佢退休嘅，而家日日去飲茶。
example.jyutping: keoi5 teoi3 jau1 ge3 ji4 gaa1 jat6 jat6 heoi3 jam2 caa4

rows.note: Use this for something that is no longer used, rather than something specifically taken out of production.

example.english: This old computer is retired, so we replaced it with a new one.
example.traditional: 呢部舊電腦唔再用嘅，我哋換咗新嗰部。
example.jyutping: nei1 bou6 gau6 din6 nou5 m4 zoi3 jung6 ge3 ngo5 dei6 wun6 zo2 san1 go2 bou6

rows.note: Use this specifically for a product or model that is no longer being manufactured.

example.english: This camera model is retired, so you can't buy it now.
example.traditional: 呢款相機停產嘅，而家買唔到喇。
example.jyutping: nei1 fun2 soeng1 gei1 ting4 caan2 ge3 ji4 gaa1 maai5 m4 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for a number, player, vehicle, or piece of equipment formally withdrawn from service.

example.english: This bus is retired and won't run on this route anymore.
example.traditional: 呢架巴士退役嘅，唔會再行呢條線。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaa3 baa1 si6 teoi3 jik6 ge3 m4 wui5 zoi3 haang4 nei1 tiu4 sin3
